introHtml: Custom 18 oz desk mugs offer the ideal capacity for employees who want a generous serving of coffee or tea without constant refills. Larger than standard 11 oz mugs, these 18 oz options provide room for morning brews and afternoon pick-me-ups alike. With ample surface area for full-color logo imprinting or detailed designs, these mugs make your brand a daily presence at the desk. Whether you're outfitting an office breakroom or creating a memorable promotional giveaway, 18 oz desk mugs combine practicality with prominent branding.
